scope: All18 chapters; editorial judgment complements mechanical checks
reference_calibration: CS329A reference chapters2 and5; representative CS221 pilot completed before course drafting

passes.name: Coverage
passes.evidence: All18 complete machine transcripts read; available official slide text read; section-level source spans and distinct lecture/research/teaching columns.

passes.name: Full-depth prose
passes.evidence: Persistent manufactured-part case in core chapters; guest-specific mug,towel and hospital cases; causal explanations and limitations developed before implementation.

passes.name: Mathematics
passes.evidence: Local symbols,shape/unit assumptions,hinge derivations,and original numerical or counterexample checks; balanced MathJax and actual rendering verified.

passes.name: Research
passes.evidence: Primary papers linked alongside mechanisms and bounded extensions; ASR names and source inconsistencies corrected.

passes.name: Implementation
passes.evidence: Actual18 Python examples executed; cumulative NumPy suite and three browser experiments passed.

passes.name: Exercises
passes.evidence: Six exercises per chapter with full solutions; computation,derivation,assumptions,counterexamples,and design judgment represented.

passes.name: Prose
passes.evidence: Definitions precede consequential use; claims distinguish model assumptions,mechanisms,empirical evidence,and limits.

passes.name: Parity
passes.evidence: Compared explanatory work with calibrated reference: recurring cases,derivations,checked implementations,integrated primary research,and reasoned solutions; no word-count-only completion rule.

passes.name: Validation
passes.evidence: All chapter code,source interval bounds,local links,MathJax,desktop/mobile DOM,controls,offline rendering,and privacy scan passed.
